reviewer: claude, from frames and the issue text

steps.action: excalidraw.com in Chrome on Android, a selected circle in the middle of the canvas
long-presses the circle; the element context menu opens
taps away, menu closes and selection clears
long-presses empty canvas below the circle; the canvas context menu (Paste ... Stats for nerds) opens
long-presses again, menu opens below the circle and closes at 00:07.8
selects the circle and drags it to the top-left of the canvas
long-presses the circle, then again at 00:14.6, each time the element context menu opens

actual: The context menu opens in one place and then jumps: the canvas menu appears fully under the circle at 00:03.97-00:04.10 and at 00:04.17 jumps to the right edge where it is cut off ('Copy to clipbo...'). The element menu at 00:14.63-00:14.83 opens next to the circle's top edge and at 00:14.90 drops lower so its bottom items (Flip vertical, Create link, Duplicate, Lock, Delete) run off the bottom of the screen; same downward shift at 00:11.2 -> 00:11.5. The first element menu (00:00.8-00:03.0) sits at the right edge, partly off-screen.
decisive: 00:04.10 -> 00:04.17: the canvas context menu, already shown fully below the circle, jumps to the right screen edge and is clipped
not_visible: device model and browser version (only Chrome UI and excalidraw.com are visible)
touch points: long-presses are inferred from the menu appearing
scrolling inside the menu is not attempted
notes: Phone screen recording, 30 fps, no touch indicators. The jump is 1-2 frames, visible only at >=15 fps.
